presets.description: Box geometry with Preview Geometry plus Voxelize →Assign Block Type →Preview Blocks. Shows Geometry Preview vs Block Preview. Local-space teaching preset centered at world origin.
Box →Linear Array →Transform →Preview Geometry, plus Voxelize →Preview Blocks for the transformed result.

Subtracts a centered cutter from a base box. Difference is a deferred voxel boolean evaluated on the Minecraft block grid. Preview Geometry shows the continuous base and cutter; Preview Blocks shows the cut result.

16-block span with a central round arch cut through the bridge body, deck beam, and side railings. Difference is a deferred voxel boolean evaluated on the Minecraft block grid. Preview Geometry and Preview Blocks share the same moved composite result.

Hollow 1-block-thick cylindrical tower with a ground-level round arch door, a top deck slab, and 12 polar-array battlements. Difference booleans are deferred voxel cuts on the block grid. Preview Geometry and Preview Blocks share the same moved composite.

12×4×10 building volume → floor / wall / window+door openings → difference cut walls → window frames on frames → gable roof with overhang → Preview + block preview. Shared opening_depth (0.6) exceeds wall_thickness (0.4) for through-wall cutters.
Floor →Wall Along Path →Difference (Window openings) →Window Frame →Roof →Preview.

Floor → Wall Along Path → Window Difference → Frames → Roof → Combine → Move to Player. Preview Geometry is the design preview after Move. Voxelize → Assign Block Type placements feed both Preview Blocks and Apply Changes. Manual Trigger EXEC fires Apply (OVERWRITE, async bake, undo).

Wall Slab host → Difference (Window Array openings as sole cutter; depth = 2× wall thickness for centered cutters through outward wall) + Window Frame on frames → Combine → Preview. Window Array owns opening count/size/placement.

Footprint Top Face → Floor Slab (Slab Thickness) → Beam Grid on slab Bottom Face (Columns/Rows/Depth/Beam Drop hang below bottom). Volume is footprint carrier only (sizeY ≠ slab thickness). Combine → Preview Geometry; Center Lines → Preview Curves.
Roof Base (explicit gable/height/overhang) → Primary Eave Path (PATH) drives one Railing; All Eaves (PATH_LIST) → Preview Curves.input_paths → Combine → Preview Geometry.
Stacked Column nodes (base, shaft, capital) with Frame placement and shape dropdowns (cylinder/box/frustum) → Preview Geometry, Voxelize → Assign Block Type → Preview Blocks.
Open-bottom door frame (jambs + head; no sill): outer box − Y-through inner opening → Preview Geometry, Voxelize → Assign Block Type → Preview Blocks.

Building volume 10×4×8 (wall top at local Y=4 / ~playerY+4) → top face → Roof Base with explicit gable type, ridge direction, overhang, and height → Preview Geometry, Voxelize → Assign Block Type → Preview Blocks.
Local origin tangent path → Staircase (spiral) + center post driven by the same spiral_height / spiral_core_radius → Preview Geometry, Voxelize → Assign Block Type → Preview Blocks.
Horizontal plan path (run=12) → Staircase (straight); Step Rise owns elevation (12×0.25=3). Preview Geometry, Voxelize → Assign Block Type → Preview Blocks.

XY facade plane: rectangle + semicircle on rect top → UNION → Extrude cutter for frame Difference + short Extrude glass → Combine preview; dual material (smooth_quartz frame / glass) → Merge → Preview Blocks.

Wall Slab host → Difference (Window Array openings; depth = 2× wall thickness) + Window Frame + glass pane on frames → Combine preview; triple material (wall / frame / glass) → Merge → Preview Blocks.
Basin with floor (inner cutter starts at Y=0.25) − hollow + tier + spout seated on the floor → Preview Geometry, Voxelize → Assign Block Type → Preview Blocks.
Square host: floor slab + polar columns + gable Roof Base. Shared pavilion_height drives volume sizeY and column tops → Preview Geometry, Voxelize → Assign Block Type → Preview Blocks.
Player Position →Box →Preview Geometry, and Voxelize →Assign Block Type →Preview Blocks. Canonical NodeCraft v1 quickstart chain.
Player Position →Sphere →Preview Geometry, and Voxelize →Assign Block Type →Preview Blocks.
Wall Box − through-cut Gate Box (Z extends beyond both wall faces; ground-level opening with a 1-block lintel) → Move to player → Preview Geometry, Voxelize → Assign Block Type → Preview Blocks.
Outer Cylinder − through-cut Inner Cylinder → hollow tower shell (open top and bottom) → Move to player → Preview Geometry, Voxelize → Assign Block Type → Preview Blocks.

Tower Height drives hollow shell top and cone base; balcony ring Boolean; shell/balcony stone vs purple roof materials → Merge Placements → Preview Blocks. Preview Geometry combines moved shell+balcony+roof.
Keep mass + parametric 2×2 Column Grid corner towers on footprint Top Face, plus rectangular roof-edge battlements (linear arrays of merlons) → Preview Geometry and block preview chain.

Glass shell − inner void with Beam Grid mullions/transoms on the framed front facade; dual Assign Block Type → Merge Placements → Preview Blocks. Preview Geometry combines moved glass + frame (shared translation).
